function.name: get_book_status
function.description: Retrieves the current availability status of a specific book, indicating whether it is in stock, checked out, or reserved.

book_title.description: The title of the book to check the availability status for.

function.name: renew_books
function.description: Allows a user to extend the borrowing period for books currently checked out, subject to library policies and availability.

library_number.description: The identifier of the library account.

book_names.description: The names of the books to be renewed.

function.name: reserve_book
function.description: Enables a user to place a reservation on a book that is currently loaned out, notifying the user when the book becomes available.

book_title.description: The title of the book to be reserved

card_number.description: The card number of the user who is reserving the book

book_format.description: The desired format of the book, e.g. hardcover, paperback, ebook etc.

function.name: get_late_fees
function.description: Calculates any late fees accrued on a user’s account for books not returned by their due date, potentially offering breakdowns by book or date range.

library_ID.description: The unique identifier of a library user's account

function.name: apply_for_membership
function.description: Facilitates the process for users to apply for a new membership with the library or bookstore, which may include online forms and submission of required documents.

city_of_residence.description: The city that the user currently resides in

function.name: make_payment
function.description: Processes payments made by users for various services, including late fees, membership fees, or purchasing books, offering multiple payment methods.

account_number.description: The library account number of the user making the payment.

payment_amount.description: The amount to be paid by the user.

payment_method.description: The method by which the user chooses to make the payment. Eg. Credit card, PayPal, etc.
